Ramallah Business & Professional Network

A network for members in business and the professions: training courses, mentoring, networking events and a mixer at the Convention. It holds one voting seat on the AFRP Board.

Branch
Leadership · A ladder by capacity
Owning entity
AFRP (a committee)
Shape
other · flagship
Built in the Hub
Built

Who it's for

AFRP members at any career stage, in fields from healthcare and STEM to law and the arts.

The operating year

A mixer during Convention week, included in base registration. Other meeting cadence is not published.

The five rungs

RungFor this programme
HearA consented professional field on the member record; every field is its own switch.
Show upThe Convention mixer, included in registration; check-in is the evidence.
Take partEnrolment in the network and attendance at training courses. A directory entry alone is not rung 3.
Give or serveMentoring, teaching a session or sponsoring; a mentor sees only their own mentee, and only while paired.
LeadThe RBPN seat on the AFRP Board (By-Law 6.2.2), seated by motion.

Who runs it

The RBPN Committee, which holds one voting seat on the AFRP Board. What it escalates is not stated.

Money

An AFRP committee. Income is listing subscriptions and sponsorships; paying for a listing on the platform is not decided, so the desk records payment and does not charge.

Hand-offs

Fed by Leadership Ramallah, scholarship alumni and the Convention mixer. Feeds mentoring, Medical Mission recruiting and Board service.

What it needs

From the Federation's strategy
  • A five-year plan: mentorship, ambassadors, conferences (2019 plan)
  • Recruit 21-35 year-olds through RBPN (2023 minutes)
From the platform
  • Sponsorship desk and job board are built (slice 10); mentoring pairs are designed, not built
  • A joining mechanism for the network, needed for rung 3, is not published
  • Live payments wait on slice 5 (gated on credentials)
  • Ambassadors and conferences are not in the record

Open questions

  • Membership cost, joining mechanism and meeting cadence beyond the Convention mixer are not published
  • Listing tiers and prices for the professional directory
